source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of opiates and opioid receptors (PDF 235-236).

blocks.text: Opiates dawaon ki aik qism hai jo afeem (opium poppy) ke paude se aati hai. Yeh taqatwar dard-kush hain lekin nasha (addiction) bhi paida karti hain. Kitab morphine, codeine, oxycodone aur hydrocodone ko qanooni dawayein, aur heroin aur fentanyl ko ghair-qanooni mein shumar karti hai.

blocks.title: Opiates aur opioids
blocks.text: Durust taur par opiates afeem ke qudrati compounds hain (morphine, codeine). Oxycodone, hydrocodone aur heroin in se banaye jate hain, aur fentanyl poori tarah masnoi hai; in sab ko opioids kehte hain. Fentanyl qanooni nuskhe wali dawa bhi hai (maslan behoshi mein), agarche ghair-qanooni taur par bhi banayi aur bechi jati hai.

blocks.title: Opioid receptors
blocks.text: Insani dimagh apne dard-kush banata hai jinhein endorphins kehte hain, jo markazi nizam-e-asaab (CNS) mein opioid receptors se jurte hain. Opiates is qudrati nizam ko 'agwa' kar lete hain: yeh dard door karte lekin bohat nasha-awar bhi hain.

items: Mu receptors dimagh aur haram maghz (spinal cord) mein hain. Yeh morphine jaise zyada tar opioids ka bara hadaf hain aur dard door karte hain, lekin in ka mutaharrik hona saans ki susti (respiratory depression) aur shadeed sarshari (euphoria) bhi paida kar sakta hai.
Kappa receptors haram maghz mein dard door karne aur ghunoodgi (sedation) mein shamil hain, lekin sarshari se kam talluq rakhte hain.
Delta receptors jazbati radd-e-amal aur mizaj ke tawazun mein ahem kirdar ada karte hain.

blocks.text: Opiates dimagh aur haram maghz mein opioid receptors naam ke khaas proteins se jur kar kaam karte hain, jaise taale (receptor) mein chabi (opiate). Jab opiate jurta hai to dard ke signals dimagh tak pohanchne se rok deta hai, is liye dard kam mehsoos hota hai. Asal mein jurne se calcium channels band aur potassium channels khul jate hain. Is se neuron hyperpolarise ho jata hai aur cell ke liye dard ka signal bhejna bohat mushkil ho jata hai. Opiates dimagh ke reward markaz mein dopamine ki bari miqdar bhi kharij karwate hain, jo sukoon aur khushhali ka ehsas deti hai.

blocks.alt: Nerve-cell membrane ki patti: baen taraf receptor (lock) mein opiate (key) jura hai; beech mein Ca2+ channel band ('closed'); daen taraf K+ channel khula jis se K+ bahar nikalta hai ('K+ flows out').
blocks.caption: Opiate ka receptor se jurna: Ca2+ channel band, K+ channel khula (asal khaaka; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.text: Opioids shadeed achanak dard (acute pain) door karne aur cancer se jure sakht dard ke ilaj mein use hote hain. Codeine khansi ke sharbat mein use hoti hai kyunke yeh khansi ka reflex dabati hai. Opioids nizam-e-hazma (gastrointestinal tract) ke receptors se bhi jurte aur hazme ko sust karte hain, is liye dast (diarrhoea) mein aaram de sakte hain.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Sarak ka nasha banne se pehle heroin (diacetylmorphine) Bayer ki trademark dawa thi jo morphine ke 'ghair nasha-awar' mutabadil aur bachon ki khansi ki dawa ke taur par bechi jati thi. Is ki taqat morphine se taqreeban paanch guna hai aur yeh khoon-dimagh ki rukawat (blood-brain barrier) tezi se paar karti, jis se aik 'josh' paida hota jo duniya bhar mein nashe ki waba ka sabab bana.

blocks.prompt: Morphine ka bara hadaf kaun sa opioid receptor hai, aur is ke mutaharrik hone se kaun se side effects ho sakte hain?
blocks.explanation: Mu receptor; dard door karne ke ilawa yeh saans ki susti aur shadeed sarshari paida kar sakta hai.

items: Opiates opioid receptors se jurte (chabi aur taala), jism ke endorphins ki tarah.
Ca2+ channels band, K+ khulte: neuron hyperpolarise, dard ka signal ruka.
Mu, kappa, delta receptors; istemal: dard, khansi, dast; nasha-awar.
